'''Chaz Hunter''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Kabaira]]. Chaz and his father, [[Del Hunter]], joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Passages" />

==Biography==
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell in [[Eponte Spaceport|Eponte]] was [[Skirmish on Kabaira|betrayed]] from inside. Six Rebels were killed by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Del was injured but escaped, and Chaz was captured with another Rebel, [[Blaide]], and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] deserter, [[Matt Turhaya]].<ref name="Passages" />

[[File:Escape_from_Kabaira.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Blaide reveals his treachery.]]

They were later freed by a [[Identified Rebel|fellow Rebel]] and Matt's ship [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Tere Metallo]], who infiltrated the prison. During the escape, Blaide revealed himself as the traitor and tried to kill them, but he was shot by Metallo. They reached the [[Eponte Spaceport|spaceport]] where Hunter was waiting for them. The two [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] took the Rebels in Metallo's ship, the ''[[Star Quest]]'', to leave the planet. In orbit, the ship was attacked by three [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], but they escaped.<ref name="Passages" />

He later joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron]] as [[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]], flying as [[Alexandra Winger|Alex Winger's]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] before her capture by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']].<ref name="SoG" />
